notes.title: Update - fixing Lonefield Evacuation Survivor Demo & adding some stuffs
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45365417/56d99fdeb9c360d4b4788a568eacbb5a9994c705.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45365417/a62d5eacc17a627bb1d492d5d527c7b18ee9e4ba.png[/img][/url]
Dear Players,

At the launch of the Lonefield Evacuation Survivor demo, many of you experienced disrupted gameplay due to the presence of multiple bugs.

Here is the first update, aimed at fixing most of the issues encountered and improving your experience with the demo.
A second update is expected to follow this one.

As a bonus, new special weapons and upgrades are now available in the game.

As always, feel free to share your feedback.
